title: BOPbI
wikitext:
BOPbl was a Polish QuakeWorld clan founded by [[Amber]] and [[po-tolo]]. Due to the differences between the Cyrillic and Latin alphabet, the clan is actually called ''Vory''. ''BOPbl'' is Russian and means ''thieves''. The clan has never been officially disbanded but is inactive.
